text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-probe-017","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_batch7","campaign_class":"benign_oer_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before deposition"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-0712","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO substrate"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"thickness":150},"comment":"NiFeCoSn baseline, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":120,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"label: within-spec standard crystallization step (probe: exceeds typical FTO thermal limit while labeled in-spec)"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-0712","x":12,"y":8},"comment":"locate deposited spot"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"chronopotentiometry at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"duration":24},"comment":"24 h stability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"dataset":"batch7","objective":"overpotential_min"},"comment":"refit surrogate with new point"}]}
